## Closes

`Closes #<issue number>` (or a specific checklist item within it, if the issue is split across teammates)

## What I personally built

One or two sentences. This is what your instructor reads to attribute individual contribution, so be specific: not "worked on the baseline," but "built the retrieval subset runner and the accuracy-comparison table against the paper's own results."

## How I checked it works

- [ ] Ran it myself against at least one real example or task
- [ ] Added or updated a test under `tests/`
- [ ] `pytest` passes locally

## Reviewer

Tag one teammate. They should read the diff, run it, and ask at least one real question before approving, not rubber-stamp it.
